caveats: Per-era fragility: AUC swings 0.15 / cut-point swings 0.5 across OFF/LOW/HIGH — the threshold may not hold once stim changes.

Underpowered and NOT rescuable by more data: 80% power would require 1,479 independent ratings at the point AUC, beyond the 500 ceiling for a realistic single-participant study. Because required n scales as 1/(AUC-0.5)^2, this is a restatement of 'indistinguishable from chance', not a collection target. Currently 83 ratings.
Selection bias: this band was chosen from a sweep on the same data; the OR/AUC are optimistic. Out-of-sample / prospective confirmation is the honest test.

FORWARD VALIDATION FAILED: held-out AUC 0.4 (95% CI 0.26–0.56) collapses to chance, although the in-sample AUC is 0.58 (forward optimism 0.18). Training on the past does not predict the future for this band — do NOT program it as an adaptive threshold on the in-sample number alone.

ramp.ramp_down_hint: moderate, may be set slightly faster than ramp-up for comfort on stim reduction
ramp.ramp_up_hint: moderate starting rate, titrate up to comfort
ramp.reason: Advisory only — the deployable ramp rate is patient- and side-effect-bound and must be titrated in clinic. This is a starting posture from the biomarker's polarity, adaptive-range validity, and stim-stability.
ramp.transition_note: Biomarker is stim-stable — a moderate transition is a reasonable starting posture; titrate to the patient's comfort and side-effect threshold in clinic.

device_control.suggested_mode_reason: positive-direction biomarker maps onto Dual/Single adaptive directly (stim ramps up as the biomarker rises)

auc_current_removed.descriptive_only: Descriptive only: the plain reading sets every gate and the verdict; this one moves none of them (the PI, 2026-09-22).
auc_current_removed.interval_method: the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles over resamples of whole pain reports; the plain curve's own interval is additionally bias-corrected, so the like-for-like comparison is with the plain reading on the same samples, made this same way
auc_current_removed.label: with the stimulation current taken out
auc_current_removed.partial_r_with: the high-or-low pain label (1 high, 0 low), the middle third left out
auc_current_removed.plain_direction: more power goes with less pain
auc_current_removed.why: The band power with the Right current in force at each sample taken out as a straight line, the pain scores and the high-or-low split untouched, given in the plain reading's own direction (more power goes with less pain); 0.5 is what coin flipping gives, and a value below 0.5 means the direction reversed once the current was out.
auc_current_removed.why_this_shape: a straight line, as E2's adjusted reading on this page is made (decision 242), so the two adjusted readings a reader sets side by side are made the same way; decision 241 keeps the straight line for every published adjusted number

forward.note: Expanding-window forward-chaining over 14 non-overlapping weekly test folds. Orientation and the Youden threshold are fit on the TRAIN weeks only and applied to the held-out future weeks, so the held-out AUC is genuinely out-of-sample and is NOT re-folded (it can fall below 0.5 when the band does not generalize forward). The held-out-AUC CI is a cluster bootstrap over independent held-out ratings; 'forward-validated' requires its lower bound to clear 0.5. Compare held_out_auc against in_sample_auc to read the forward optimism.

gates.detail: band 22.0–27.0 Hz (center 24.5 Hz) must fit inside 8.0–30.0 Hz
gates.label: In Percept adaptive range (8–30 Hz)

gates.detail: band×era LRT p=0.2165524406975463 did not reject, but the interval on the largest between-era difference is wider than the declared margin -- these data cannot tell a stable band from a materially unstable one (absence of evidence, not evidence of stability).
gates.label: Stim-stable (band×era equivalence test)

gates.detail: power 5%–10% (conservative–point AUC); target power NOT achievable by collecting more data (AUC indistinguishable from chance)
gates.label: Adequately powered (≥80%)

gates.detail: held-out AUC 0.4 (95% CI 0.26–0.56) collapses to chance while in-sample is 0.58 (optimism 0.18); band did NOT generalize forward — do not program on the in-sample number.
gates.label: Forward-validated (held-out AUC clears chance)

power.note: Hanley–McNeil AUC variance on the count of independent ratings (clustered effective n). Power to reject AUC = 0.5. REQUIREMENT NOT FEASIBLE: reaching 80% power would take 1,479 independent ratings, beyond the 500 ceiling for a realistic single-participant study. Because the required n scales as 1/(AUC-0.5)^2, this is a restatement of 'this band is indistinguishable from chance', NOT a data-collection target. Effective n is DISCOUNTED by a design effect of 1.48 (audit [16]/[19]): weekly ratings are serially autocorrelated, so the moving-block bootstrap variance exceeds the i.i.d. cluster bootstrap by this factor. Power and ratings-needed are reported on the discounted effective n; the x-axis is real ratings collected. Power BAND reported across [auc_lo, auc]; the 'powered' gate reads the conservative auc_lo end (audit C4) so it cannot pass on the optimistic point AUC.

temporal_validity.note: forward_validation = expanding-window weekly forward-chaining held-out AUC vs chance (audit C2). stim_state_portability = per-era CI-overlap + LRT (audit C3); this is robustness to stim STATE. threshold_drift = OLS trend test of the weekly Youden cut-point vs week index (audit [18]); 'drift_detected' means the cut-point moves systematically over calendar time and a fixed device threshold needs periodic recalibration.

Dual.label: Dual Threshold
Dual.note: Timeline-anchored upper threshold 143.0 LSB is a STARTING POINT: it is read off the 10-min Timeline average, while Dual Threshold adapts on a 1200 ms window. Shorter averaging widens the tails, so confirm/raise the threshold live while sensing in Dual Threshold before enabling adaptive.

Single.label: Single Threshold
Single.note: Single Threshold uses a 64-pt FFT, but the device Timeline LSB (and this calibration) is 256-pt. LFP Power is not comparable across FFT sizes, so the Timeline-anchored threshold does NOT translate to this mode — recapture the threshold while sensing in Single Threshold before deploying.

SingleInverse.label: Single Threshold Inverse
SingleInverse.note: Sensing-only mode (no adaptive actuation): the Timeline-anchored upper threshold 143.0 LSB is reviewed against, not acted on. 256-pt FFT, 3000 ms averaging.

chosen.label: Dual Threshold
chosen.note: Timeline-anchored upper threshold 143.0 LSB is a STARTING POINT: it is read off the 10-min Timeline average, while Dual Threshold adapts on a 1200 ms window. Shorter averaging widens the tails, so confirm/raise the threshold live while sensing in Dual Threshold before enabling adaptive.
